# scm_dlp_dry_run_scan (Action)

Runs an Enterprise DLP dry-run scan against a data profile using multipart form-data.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Scan a local file against a candidate data profile without enforcing it.
#
# Usage:
#   terraform apply -invoke=action.scm_dlp_dry_run_scan.check

action "scm_dlp_dry_run_scan" "check" {
  config {
    file_path = "${path.module}/sample.txt"
    data_profile = jsonencode({
      name = "dry-run"
      detection_rules = [{
        rule_type = "expression_tree"
        expression_tree = {
          operator_type = "or"
          sub_expressions = [{
            rule_item = {
              id                       = "REPLACE_WITH_DATA_PATTERN_ID"
              detection_technique      = "weighted_regex"
              occurrence_operator_type = "any"
            }
          }]
        }
      }]
    })
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `data_profile` (String) JSON string representing the data profile configuration to test.

### Optional

- `dry_run_service_name` (String) Optional dry-run service name (defaults to prisma-access).
- `file_content` (String) Raw content of the file to scan. Either file_path or file_content must be provided.
- `file_name` (String) Name of the file being scanned (defaults to 'sample.txt' if file_content is used).
- `file_path` (String) Path to the file to upload and scan. Either file_path or file_content must be provided.
- `file_sha` (String) SHA256 hex string of the file (computed automatically if omitted).
- `source_data_profile_id` (String) Optional source data profile ID.
